messages:
alex_h: FYI incoming support case — customer says promo shows accepted but no credits in balance. they attached the confirmation email.
customer_julia: Hi — I redeemed code SPRING50 via the promo page, got the 'Success! Credits applied' email, but my dashboard balance still shows $0. Screenshot attached. Can you check? :frowning:
maria_support: Thanks Julia — can you confirm org id and the email you used to sign up? Also which page you used to redeem (web/app)?
customer_julia: Org ID is org-7542, email julia+trial@acme.com. Redeemed on account.redwood.com/redeem (web). Email shows grant id g_98765 and amount $100.
alex_h: I see email webhook ack in logs for g_98765. billing_bot, can you dump the grant->ledger mapping for that id?
billing_bot: webhook: grant.accepted id=g_98765 org_mapped=org-legacy-123 amount=100.00 status=ingested
billing_bot: ledger_mapping: grant.g_98765 -> ledger.account=org-legacy-123 entry_id=null
maria_support: Hmm looks like it mapped to a different org (org-legacy-123). Julia — do you by any chance have multiple orgs or were you migrated from an older account?
customer_julia: I used to have an older account (org-legacy-123) which I asked to be merged last month. But current account is org-7542 and I never added payment info there yet.
jonathan_eng: :eyes: probable cause — grant mapping is using the legacy account id from the user profile instead of the active org context. Need to check the grant ingestion path where we resolve user->org. Repro steps I want: 1) login as julia+trial@acme.com with two orgs 2) POST /api/redeem with org header for org-7542 3) inspect grant record in grants table and grant.account_id resolution.
jonathan_eng: Quick query to validate:
```
SELECT id, user_email, requested_org, resolved_account_id, status, created_at
FROM grants
WHERE id='g_98765';
```
jonathan_eng: Also check audit log for user-org merges:
```
SELECT * FROM org_merges WHERE user_email='julia+trial@acme.com' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5;
```
sara_ops: If confirmed mapped incorrectly, workaround is manual ledger credit to org-7542 and mark grant as remapped. I'll prepare a one-off ledger entry and note the audit. Need approval from finance for $100 promo.
maria_support: I've asked customer to confirm no billing attached to org-legacy-123 and gave ETA. escalating to eng + ops.
billing_bot: trace: ingress.headers.X-Org-ID=org-7542, user.email=julia+trial@acme.com, grant.id=g_98765, resource=redeem-web-v2, resolved_account=org-legacy-123, resolver_service=v1.14.2
jonathan_eng: Thanks — that resolver version had a known edge-case with merged orgs (see changelog 1.14.2 -> 1.14.3). Plan: patch resolver to prefer explicit X-Org-ID when present and re-run mapping for recent grants in the window. I'll open an internal ticket and add remediation steps.
jonathan_eng: Opening ticket: INF-3412 — "grant resolver: prefer explicit org header; remap mis-routed grants". Assigned to me. ETA for hotfix: ~3h. Will run backfill script for affected grants after deploy.
sara_ops: Finance, can someone pre-approve manual $100 credit to org-7542 while we fix backfill? I will include reference g_98765 and auditors will reconcile.
alex_h: Finance notified (cc @finance-team). Maria, keep customer updated and offer temporary promo re-issue if they'd prefer immediate unblock instead of waiting for ledger backfill.
maria_support: Noted. Julia — we can either (A) issue manual credit to your account now, or (B) wait for our backfill which should post within a few hours. Which do you prefer?
customer_julia: If it helps, manual credit would be great — we need to run a few experiments today. Thanks for the quick responses.
sara_ops: Ok proceeding with manual ledger entry:
```
POST /internal/ledger/entries
{
  "account_id": "org-7542",
  "amount": 100.00,
  "currency": "USD",
  "type": "promo_adjustment",
  "reference": "grant:g_98765 manual remap",
  "note": "Customer redeem email accepted; original grant mapped to org-legacy-123 due to resolver bug. INF-3412"
}
```
sara_ops: created pending entry id=le_2026_manual_332, will be applied after finance sign-off.
finance: approved: le_2026_manual_332. Please attach audit with emails and webhook headers.
sara_ops: applied entry le_2026_manual_332 -> posted to org-7542 balance +100.00. Customer should see updated balance in ~30s.
maria_support: Julia — can you check your dashboard and confirm balance update?
customer_julia: I see +$100 now, thank you so much! Really appreciate the fast help. :tada:
maria_support: Closing the customer-facing loop. We'll keep INF-3412 open until we backfill and reconcile all affected grants and update the audit. Thanks all for the quick turnaround. :heart:
